value: mutate the 5' or 3' nearest neighbour to the base that maximises |dG-deg3bp|
outcome_definition: Rule, not an outcome. |dG-deg3bp| is the change in Gibbs free energy over the 3 bp (i-NNN, i, i+NNN) using SantaLucia (1998) unified NN parameters at 37 C; it is a free-energy proxy for dTm, NOT a melting-temperature threshold. The 1.43 kcal/mol cut is the authors' choice for Exp. 3; they state only that > 1.0 kcal/mol with < 80 bp 'would generally guarantee dTm > 0.5 C'.
